title: CoreWeave, Super Micro surge on signs of sustained AI buildout
excerpt: Shares of CoreWeave and Super Micro Computer jumped to their highest since June on Wednesday after upbeat forecasts from the two ‌AI infrastructure companies...
content_html:
By Akriti Shah

Aug 12 (Reuters) - Shares of CoreWeave and Super Micro Computer jumped to their highest since June on Wednesday after upbeat forecasts from the two ‌AI infrastructure companies signaled booming demand for computing capacity.

Both companies have been beneficiaries of ‌the insatiable demand for AI infrastructure, as data center operators build out the hardware needed for generative-AI workloads.

Shares of ​AI cloud provider CoreWeave rose more than 19%, with peer Nebius Group rising 23% as it beat quarterly revenue estimates. Server maker Super Micro's shares climbed more than 13%.

Data center companies Applied Digital and IREN Ltd were also up 4% and 8%, respectively. Shares of Dell were 5% higher.

CoreWeave ‌is on track to add ⁠around $8 billion to its market value, while Super Micro could add more than $2 billion, if gains persist. More than seven brokerages raised their price targets ⁠on both CoreWeave and Super Micro stocks.

CoreWeave raised its forecasts for annual revenue, adjusted operating profit and capital spending, as strong demand for its Nvidia-powered AI infrastructure enabled the company to secure better ​pricing ​on new contracts.

Near-term capacity is effectively sold out, enabling ​CoreWeave to strike compute agreements on ‌increasingly favorable terms, CEO Michael Intrator said.

Its revenue backlog rose to $104.2 billion in the second quarter from $99.4 billion three months earlier, excluding over $25 billion in new commitments secured early this quarter.

"Some investors may be spooked by the increased capex guidance, but the pricing environment would suggest that project returns are strengthening, even if unit costs are going up too," MoffettNathanson analysts said ‌in a note.

Tech companies have boosted their capital expenditure ​to feed the AI boom, piling on massive debt ​in the process, and in turn prompting ​a surge in hedging against the default risk of these heavily indebted 'hyperscalers'.

Major ‌U.S. financial institutions are also seeking to ​capitalize on the data ​center buildout. Bank of America pledged $250 billion for U.S. infrastructure financing by July 2027, days after a similar announcement from Morgan Stanley.

Super Micro forecast 2027 revenue above Wall Street ​estimates, underscoring resilient customer investment ‌in AI servers.

The company's fourth-quarter gross margin of 17.5% exceeded both its preliminary ​estimate of 15%-17% and its initial forecast of 8.2%-8.4%.

(Reporting by Akriti Shah and ​Jaspreet Singh in Bengaluru; Editing by Devika Syamnath)

content_html_zh:
作者：阿克里蒂·沙阿

路透 8 月 12 日 - CoreWeave 和 Super Micro Computer 的股价周三跃升至 6 月以来的最高水平，此前这两家人工智能基础设施公司的乐观预测表明对计算能力的需求蓬勃发展。

随着数据中心运营商构建生成人工智能工作负载所需的硬件，两家公司都成为了对人工智能基础设施永不满足的需求的受益者。

人工智能云提供商 CoreWeave 的股价上涨了 19% 以上，同行 Nebius Group 的股价上涨了 23%，因为该公司的季度收入超出了预期。 服务器制造商Super Micro的股价上涨了13%以上。

数据中心公司 Applied Digital 和 IREN Ltd 也分别上涨 4% 和 8%。 戴尔股价上涨 5%。

CoreWeave 的市值有望增加约 80 亿美元，而如果收益持续增长，Super Micro 的市值可能会增加超过 20 亿美元。 超过七家券商上调了 CoreWeave 和 Super Micro 股票的价格目标。

CoreWeave 上调了对年收入、调整后营业利润和资本支出的预测，因为对其由 Nvidia 驱动的人工智能基础设施的强劲需求使该公司能够在新合同上获得更好的定价。

首席执行官迈克尔·因特拉特 (Michael Intrator) 表示，近期产能实际上已经售罄，这使得 CoreWeave 能够以越来越优惠的条件达成计算协议。

第二季度，其积压收入从三个月前的 994 亿美元增至 1042 亿美元，不包括本季度初承诺的超过 250 亿美元的新承诺。

MoffettNathanson 分析师在一份报告中表示：“一些投资者可能会对资本支出指引的增加感到惊慌，但定价环境表明，即使单位成本也在上升，项目回报也在增强。”

科技公司增加了资本支出来满足人工智能的繁荣，在此过程中积累了大量债务，进而促使对冲这些负债累累的“超大规模企业”的违约风险激增。

美国主要金融机构也在寻求利用数据中心建设。 美国银行承诺到 2027 年 7 月为美国基础设施融资提供 2500 亿美元，几天前摩根士丹利也发布了类似声明。

Super Micro 预测 2027 年收入高于华尔街预期，突显客户对 AI 服务器的投资具有弹性。

该公司第四季度毛利率为 17.5%，超过其初步估计的 15%-17% 和最初预测的 8.2%-8.4%。

（Akriti Shah 和 Jaspreet Singh 班加罗尔报道；Devika Syamnath 编辑）
